checkedAlternates.risk: Juan de Fuca is often listed alongside Cocos as a remnant of the Farallon Plate.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Juan de Fuca (~250,000 km²) is a microplate (group-1), much smaller than the Cocos and Caribbean plates (~3M km², group-2).
The Indian Plate (~11.9M km²) is classified as a secondary plate (group-3), distinct from the seven major plates >20M km² (group-4).
